Backstage Log In Create Account × BD-2 Blues Driver Where to Buy --> Home Effects Pedals Distortion/Overdrive/Fuzz BD-2 Home BD-2 Features Specs Guide/Articles --> Guide/Articles Accessories --> Accessories Downloads --> Downloads Support Expressive Touch Sensitivity Sweet, nuanced, and ultra-expressive, the BD-2 Blues Driver stands as an enduring icon in the annals of guitar overdrive. Its influential BOSS analog circuit design behaves like a tube amp, providing natural, touch-responsive gain that’s not possible with standard overdrive and distortion pedals. Nearly three decades on, the BD-2’s articulate voice continues to power the sounds of players in every musical genre, from blues and rock to country, jazz, and beyond. View the Gallery Features Classic BOSS overdrive pedal, in continuous production since 1995 Innovative amp-like gain circuit with organic tone and rich harmonic content Highly responsive to picking dynamics and guitar volume changes Wide gain range supports a variety of applications, from a transparent clean boost to aggressive overdrive Tone control for shaping the high-end response BOSS five-year warranty Landmark Amp-Style Circuit From the beginning, the BD-2 was conceived by BOSS engineers to reproduce the interactive gain and compression properties of a tube amplifier. To meet this goal, they developed a unique multi-stage clipping circuit inspired by actual amps. This innovative design delivers a very organic playing experience, with drive character and harmonic content that changes with your picking attack and sound that smoothly cleans up as you roll back the volume. Clean to Mean Don’t be boxed in by the name—the versatile sound of the Blues Driver circuit flows with any guitar style. Lower gain settings produce a mild breakup that’s ideal for defined chord work, arpeggio playing, and adding body to lead lines. The tone gets fatter and more saturated as you crank the gain, mimicking the behavior of a vintage tube amp.
